Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing acquisition of federal property by eminent domain.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to acquisition of federal property by eminentdomain; adding a new section to chapter 8.04 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 8.26 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 8.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to section 2 of this act, property that may be appropriatedunder this chapter includes property possessed by the federalgovernment, unless the property was acquired by the federal governmentwith the consent of the legislature and in accordance with the UnitedStates Constitution Article I, section 8, clause 17.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 8.26 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to acquisitions under section 1 of thisact.
